name: Freeze the baseline and define the scanner boundary
deliverable: A reproducible development organization/workspace and the minimal capture/exchange contracts. This is setup, not an application-platform build.
work: Preserve both donor branches by commit, keep history/license provenance, and run their own tests in their locked environments before reuse.
Import the v4.1 contract baseline; retain its broad 213-predicate catalog and all current regression tests.
Record every workbook sheet and command ID. Add capability/command execution and scan bundle specifications without changing source terminology.
Pin Python, Scrapling 0.4.15 initially, browser binaries, schema/rule/profile versions; characterize the exact response/session API before coding against examples.
Set read-only/single-tenant local development defaults, no live spending or sending, approved fixture origins, secrets and CI boundaries.
Make the absent 99_MASTER_ALL footprint library and actual deployment/provider permissions explicit input dependencies, not invented data.
acceptance: Clean setup runs baseline 588 tests (current rerun passed); donor tests are separately required, not claimed run here.
All 38 command IDs have a handler owner, phase and acceptance case in a checked registry.
No arbitrary registry-supplied Python import or command execution is allowed.
The app can proceed with reviewed donor/starter rules without claiming the missing 25-vertical master library is loaded.

name: Ship the first live Scrapling evidence collector
deliverable: Direct URL/host input → safe static capture → retained artifact/attempt → resumable versioned scan bundle, with no LLM or outreach.
work: Implement normalization, per-origin policy, public-address/redirect guards and request reservations before fetch.
Use Scrapling HTTP sessions; persist response bytes, encoding, response metadata, redirect chain, request identity and truncation.
Record timeouts, denied/no-byte attempts, rate-limit events and budget skips explicitly. Never manufacture empty HTML or a business absence.
Use a single writer, bounded queues and active-domain window, cancellation, resumable target state and atomic bundle completion.
Run extractor output against the actual bytes retained; incomplete/oversized captures remain limited evidence.
acceptance: A permitted test site produces a complete replayable capture with all source/evidence references.
Robots/policy denial, malformed URL, DNS failure, redirect to private address, 429 and oversized content have tested terminal states.
Kill/restart does not duplicate a completed capture or lose failed-target diagnostics.
Normal crawl has no model calls, no external form submissions and no outbound message operations.

name: Complete all 38 commands and the browser capture path
deliverable: The complete workbook command suite, all extraction surfaces, host qualification/scoring and an evidence-preserving fact-candidate adapter.
work: Implement all 17 extraction commands and the two discovery commands, preserving per-node and per-page provenance.
Compile typed catalog matchers and guards; run host accumulation before host matching/gating, then finalize output.
Add separately bounded browser rendering under the original FETCH_STEALTH ID; retain actual engine, trigger, static/rendered artifacts and capture limitations.
Capture network metadata through an explicitly version-tested browser hook when required; leave DNS/TLS and other extras as separately registered capabilities beyond the original 38.
Emit the workbook's HostResult and Hit projections plus the richer ScanBundle/attempts/evidence needed by v4.1.
Support no-send detection/scanning profiles and offline replay from day one; no source status or catalog score can grant production authority.
acceptance: 38/38 command handlers have positive/negative/error or not-applicable fixtures and evidence outputs; each run records every applicable command's disposition.
All template-path slots and selector surfaces from the workbook are mapped; skipped probes are not represented as missing software.
Boundary tests include hostname lookalikes, comments, quoted attributes, noscript, multiple JSON-LD subjects, deep seeds and same-host multi-page guards.
Budget counters include failures/redirects/retries and separately bound browser subrequests.
Recorded HTTP and browser captures replay to equivalent substantive detections without another live request.

name: Integrate dynamic fingerprint discovery, review and release
deliverable: The scanner learns recurring unknown surfaces through a review-gated rule release loop, not runtime self-promotion.
work: Inventory/import all donor rule definitions with original IDs, hashes, statuses and a disposition report; account for all 739 manifest-listed rows.
Adapt RuleLibrary/FingerprintRuleEngine behavior, catalog normalization, candidate export/review and pack validation rather than treating old PageSignal values as new facts.
Preserve one observation for each distinct capture/support; deduplicate display rows without dropping rule IDs/evidence.
Queue repeated unknown normalized features using configurable unique-site thresholds; namespace private/tenant evidence and do not pool it without approval.
Use manual review initially; optional bounded LLM proposals may produce candidates only.
Validate fixture and mutation cases, shadow-compare, approve, release immutable rule packs, pin them per run and provide rollback/revocation.
Replay eligible stored captures with a new detection execution; request recapture for missing modalities and do not refresh observation time/TTL.
acceptance: Manifest inventory = imported + quarantined + non-executable records, with no silent omission.
One repeated unknown is exported, reviewed, installed, matched and replayed without recollecting compatible content.
Unsupported/candidate/research-only definitions never drive production signals or templates.
A running scan does not hot-load a new release; removal/demotion affects subsequent current-use checks.
Upstream thresholds 3/10/50 are scheduling defaults only, not proof of accuracy or statistical independence.

name: Build the persistent knowledge application and close authorization
deliverable: Scan bundles become queryable broad facts with complete producer/identity/coverage/claim-resolution checks.
work: Implement v4.1 repositories and transactional admission; initially one logical database and local content backend, not a graph database.
Consume scanner evidence/candidates through one adapter; preserve direct observation, mention, inference, provider report and contextual roles.
Implement successful-producer, input-closure, conflict, coverage, no-byte and profile gates at runtime rather than only in fixture validation.
Complete the deliberately unclosed F ChangeRecord tenant/actor/typed-replacement checks before hosted mutation or multi-tenant production.
Enforce authenticated tenant context, source use policy, revocation, retention, current view versus historical evaluation and exact input snapshots.
Provide knowledge-only batch reports and evidence/claim search without requiring a commercial signal.
acceptance: Capture → fact admission → query works with retained real/controlled fixtures and exact locators.
A stale, cross-account, candidate, conflicted, failed-producer or revoked input cannot support eligible outward use.
ChangeRecord authorization/replacement tests pass and the previous F blocker is explicitly closed before production.
Reimports are idempotent; incompatible payload reuse fails; corrections preserve history.
No output depends on the legacy rule catalog as a second authoritative fact store.

name: Expand acquisition across all fact suites
deliverable: Approved collectors and tested mappings for all 11 domain families, plus the 52-ledger source extensions, activated in source-specific batches.
work: P5a: ATS/careers/posting history and vertical product/portal evidence; distinguish public description from verified operation.
P5b: permitted local/product/app reviews and discussions, exact statements, sample dispositions and independent origin IDs.
P5c: traffic estimates, search/ads/backlinks/mentions/apps/shopping with provider, method, dimensions, periods and units.
P5d: provider/professional/corporate registries, licenses, filings, permits and authorized phone/operational records.
P5e: website/job workflow extraction, publications/transcripts/events/case studies and remaining ledger families through approved capture adapters.
Use one bounded LLM gateway with raw I/O before parse, structured output, mandatory bounded repair, cost reservations and abstention.
Preserve every source's capture/extract/use status. Unavailable permissions block that connector explicitly; fixture coverage is not live access.
acceptance: An 11-area source matrix reports actual live/fixture/disabled/blocked status and exact emitted predicates.
Each enabled source demonstrates evidence → typed facts, boundaries, pagination/timeouts and source-specific retention.
Cross-provider periods/units and current versus historical records cannot be conflated.
The 52 ledger entries remain tracked as source, fact, derivation, algorithm or template—not all reclassified as facts.

name: Implement deterministic reasoning and combination-C research context
deliverable: Selected complete signals and research priors from resolved claims and exact input/sample snapshots. This phase can progress alongside P5.
work: Port useful selectors, calculators and stage functions from Master Signals without importing its mandatory 223-evaluation terminal condition.
Implement versioned functions, typed value comparisons, UNKNOWN/error handling, temporal changes, confounds and independent support.
Bind sample support, full denominators/exclusions and every source permission to research prior eligibility.
Permit explicit product/industry links as internal context only; prevent company-pain claims from contextual priors.
Implement declared membership aggregates before provider/location rollups; keep cross-subject contamination guards.
Keep all 23 derivation designs and 18 prior signal identifiers, enabling only implemented dependency closures; implement peer/cohort algorithms before enabling their signals.
Treat compound ledger 33–40 as hypotheses/calculations requiring exact windows and evidence, not proxy-derived certainties.
acceptance: A condition with sufficient false evidence is NO_MATCH; missing evidence is UNKNOWN; operational restrictions remain separate.
Contradictions, abstained contexts or deleted denominator evidence cannot support an eligible decision.
Fixed-batch dependency order rejects same-run self/multi-node cycles; no dynamic scheduler is required.
Real stored-input integration tests complement numerical fixtures.
At least one product/industry research prior joins to account context without acquiring company-claim permission.

name: Deliver auditable intelligence and reviewed no-send outreach
deliverable: Searchable account intelligence, supported previews, exact-revision review and a current-use-gated handoff.
work: Map supported conditions to service line, audience and reviewed template; retain a valid no-opportunity outcome.
Enable observation-led questions without universal maturity gating; keep maturity/scenario/lookalike offers behind their specific proofs and implemented renderers.
Revalidate whole sentences, input ancestry and exact quotes; do not promote draft LLM prose.
Persist actual authenticated ReviewDecision, UseGateDecision and ExportReceipt records with revision/payload/destination identity.
Provide analyst views for captures, claims, candidate rules, contexts, rejections and approvals.
Reuse Master context/page selection and package mechanics only behind the new contract tests and no duplicate crawl path.
acceptance: Permitted live/retained evidence → supported preview → authenticated review → current-gated local export is demonstrated.
Corrected identity, DNC, evidence expiry/deletion or source revocation blocks stale reviewed packages.
Failed targets cannot publish approved partial output; one account failure does not erase independently completed accounts.
No sender is reachable from this profile.

name: Add explicit CRM/export and delivery integrations
deliverable: Destination-specific remote handoffs and, only when enabled, controlled sending with durable identity/reconciliation.
work: Resolve recipients and account/contact mappings without fabricating them; restrict private/internal context in exported payloads.
Separate preview/export, draft creation, append-to-existing and activation/send permissions where the destination supports them.
Implement transactional outbox, provider idempotency/correlation, lease/claim semantics as needed and immediate pre-send restrictions.
Represent uncertain acceptance explicitly and reconcile before retrying; CRM-sync failures never cause another send.
Record provider events, unsubscribe/DNC decisions and exposure identity as soon as delivery is introduced.
acceptance: No-send profiles cannot dispatch; approval of a preview is not authorization for a campaign activation.
Duplicate jobs and webhooks do not duplicate exposure/outcome identities.
Timeout-after-acceptance and restart scenarios reconcile without blind resend.
Every external action has an exact payload, gate, receipt and permission scope.

name: Close outcome measurement and harden scale/operations
deliverable: Mature descriptive performance metrics, operating dashboards, recovery and measured growth in throughput.
work: Compute outcome metrics with mature response windows, explicit exposure units, pending/bounce/uncertainty handling and contamination rules.
Keep performance descriptive; ranking experiments cannot upgrade source authority or establish causal effectiveness automatically.
Measure scanner recall/precision by rule family/vertical/modality and monitor capture failures, drift, budget use and unsupported-surface rates.
Run restore, retention/deletion, revocation, authentication and tenant-boundary tests; these controls begin earlier and are stress-tested here.
Scale from bounded local batches to measured concurrency; introduce PostgreSQL/multiple workers only with concurrency tests and demonstrated need.
Add shared atomic budgets before concurrent paid operations, not after. Incremental scheduling remains optional and must match full recomputation.
acceptance: Operational and commercial denominators are independently audited.
Backups restore tested knowledge and receipts; revoked/deleted data cannot reappear through stale projections.
Load targets and cost ceilings are chosen from measured pilot results rather than workbook estimates.
Feature release can be rolled back; approved fingerprint packs and application versions are independently pinned.
